steps.en: Install the skill into your coding agents with the interactive wizard
steps.zh: 用交互向导把 skill 装进你的编码 agent

steps.en: Adds SKILL.md telling the agent to search first on every HTML/CSS/JS task
steps.zh: 装好 SKILL.md，要求 agent 每个前端任务先搜索

steps.en: Ask the agent for a frontend feature in plain words
steps.zh: 用大白话让 agent 做一个前端功能

steps.en: Agent runs a search; the CLI ranks guides with a local embedding model
steps.zh: agent 发起搜索，CLI 用本地嵌入模型给指南排序

steps.en: Agent retrieves the guide: DO/DO NOT rules, snippets, Baseline data, fallbacks
steps.zh: agent 取回指南：要做/不要做、片段、Baseline 数据、降级

steps.en: Review the code the agent wrote with the guide in context
steps.zh: 审阅 agent 带着指南写出的代码

value.en: Native platform features with sized fallbacks instead of legacy libraries, without you pasting MDN into the prompt
value.zh: 拿到用原生平台特性、带适度降级的代码，而不是老库，也不必自己往提示词里贴 MDN

sources: https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src README.md — Quickstart `npx modern-web-guidance@latest install`; How It Works (activation, local semantic search, guide fetch)

https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance skills/modern-web-guidance/SKILL.md — `npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "<query>"`, `npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve "<id>"`, MANDATORY trigger on HTML/CSS/client JS
serving/bin/modern-web.ts — search/list/retrieve/install commands; install shells out to `npx -y skills add GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance`
serving/lib/search.ts — TF.js embedder + cosine similarity over gzipped guide vectors, top 5, min similarity 0.3
